protocol.title: Focused cross-initialization recovery confirmation

training.rule: all six L2/L3 Memory groups frozen except the registered restored subset

protocol.sufficiency_rule: final intact query gain >= 5 percentage points over all_memory_frozen in at least 3/4 endpoints
protocol.stop_rule: no extra arms, source checkpoints, thresholds, or post-hoc gates

diagnosis.interpretation_scope: Four frozen outcome-stratified endpoints; not a prevalence estimate.
diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Report the fixed parameter-group intervention. Do not add groups, layers, seeds, steps, or post-hoc gates.
